items.headline: A Decision-Theoretic View of Test-Time Training: When, How Far, and Which Directions to Adapt
items.summary:
arXiv:2606.15569v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Test-time training (TTT) adapts a pretrained model to each prompt via parameter updates, improving accuracy under pretraining-to-test distribution shifts. Yet, its performance often suffers from instability and sensitivity to hyperparameters such as update steps and subspace. items.headline: Building llm-driven “ai” still requires domain knowledge
items.summary:
I’m in the process of building an llm driven tool to take user questions and answer them using our customer api at $work.
A big part of the work is capturing the domain knowledge and writing it down. It’s easier than previous generations of “ai” because the knowledge doesn’t strictly have to be rendered into a structured format, but this is what previous generations of “ai” foundered on.
